summary_bullets: Expose COMBINED_FALLBACK_COUNT from dispatch-with-waterfall and align design degradation consumers with the combined WARN threshold
Honor combined-fallback degradation on the plan-review-loop no-findings short-circuit instead of hardcoding DEGRADED_PANEL=0
Extend waterfall and design-consumer harnesses for multi phase-2 relaunch, counter persistence, agent-slot wiring, and COMBINED-only threshold cases
commit_message:
Align design degradation with combined fallback count (#3097)

Emit COMBINED_FALLBACK_COUNT from dispatch-with-waterfall and teach plan-review design consumers to use it for DEGRADED_ROUND/PANEL decisions, including the zero-findings short-circuit. Add harness coverage for multi phase-2 relaunch, fallback-counter persistence, agent prompt sidecars, and COMBINED-only threshold scenarios.
